en.bdb: Millions of Brahmas, Visnus and Mahegas adore the Lord.
Narad, Saran and Sesanag eulogise Him.
The gams, gandharvas and Gana et al. play instruments (for Him).

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਸਾਂਗ ਬਣਾਇਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan kar ves saa(n)g banaidhe|

en.bdb: The six philosophies also propound different garbs (for reaching Him).
The gurus sermonize the disciples and the disciples act accordingly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਪਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਇਦੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes paar na paidhe ||2||

en.bdb: Salute to the primeval Lord who is unfathomable.
